_about: Region 7 (cases 61–70, Mount Kenya and the central highlands). New image descriptions for every person, place and object exhibit that had none. Apply with  npm run images:briefs -- prompts/briefs/region-07.json .

people.p_gathua: Kenyan man, about 50, a heavy army-green greatcoat with plain buttons, a woollen cap, a flask in his hand, steady, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_cashbox: a locked grey metal cash box on the floor under an office desk, untouched, close-up
evidence.ev_jack: a car jack hanging on its wall hook in a small garage bay, clean, its handle dusty, close-up
evidence.ev_padlock: a padlock hanging open on the chain of a steel yard gate, no marks on it, close-up
evidence.ev_jacket: two orange reflective work jackets hanging on pegs, block lettering on the back too blurred to read, one with a small name tag, close-up
evidence.ev_nj_prints: a police ten-print fingerprint card on a desk, ten inked fingerprints in their boxes, an ink pad beside it, the name box out of focus

people.p_kiragu: Kenyan man, about 60, a frayed tweed jacket over a sweater, a woollen hat, tea-picker's calloused hands, loyal and anxious, ID-photo framing
people.p_gakii: Kenyan woman, late 40s, a dark suit jacket over a white blouse, small pearl earrings, reading glasses, measured, ID-photo framing
people.p_wanjiku: Kenyan woman, late 60s, a headscarf, a heavy shawl over a sweater, a wrinkled watchful face, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_jiko: a burned-out metal charcoal jiko on a bedroom floor, one leg repaired with twisted wire, grey ash inside, close-up
evidence.ev_window: a small bedroom window latched shut from inside, a rag stuffed into the gap along its frame, morning mist outside, close-up
evidence.ev_bible: an old leather Bible lying open on a bedside table at the Psalms, a faded ribbon bookmark, flat clean pages, close-up

ev_hut.brief: inside a smoky farm kitchen hut, two metal charcoal jikos standing side by side on four sound legs, a pot of porridge half eaten on a low table

people.p_faith: Kenyan woman, late 20s, a neat bun, a cardigan over an office blouse, a photocopy-smudged thumb, worried she did wrong, ID-photo framing
people.p_wangui: Kenyan woman, late 50s, a headscarf, a farm jacket over a dress, a coffee-picker's hands, angry and dignified, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_mud: footprints pressed into spilled white coffee mucilage at the edge of a concrete fermentation tank: ridged gumboot prints and the sharp print of a smart leather shoe, close-up
evidence.ev_gap: a dusty office shelf of box files with one clean rectangular outline in the dust where a file is missing, close-up
evidence.ev_safe: a small locked steel safe in the corner of a factory office, a cash book lying closed on top, close-up

people.p_rhoda: Kenyan woman, early 60s, a headscarf, a cardigan over a long skirt, a bunch of keys on a ring, nosy and kind, ID-photo framing
people.p_kaguru: Kenyan man, early 50s, a reflective stage-marshal vest with no writing over a jacket, a cap, a whistle, friendly and exact, ID-photo framing

people.p_kalekye: Kenyan woman, mid 20s, braids tied back, a teacher's plain cardigan over a blouse, a stack of exercise books, bewildered, ID-photo framing
people.p_kawira: Kenyan woman, late 50s, a headscarf, a shawl, a cup of tea in her hand, curious and certain, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_wall: the top row of a stone garden wall at night lit by a torch, one block missing from the row leaving a gap, close-up

people.p_zablon: Kenyan man, about 50, a grey office cardigan over a shirt and tie, reading glasses, a rolled index map under his arm, weary and wry, ID-photo framing

people.p_josphine: Kenyan woman, late 30s, a plain olive ranger's fleece and beret with no insignia, a thick register under her arm, a wind-reddened face, ID-photo framing

people.p_lewis: Kenyan man, early 50s, a grey suit, a laptop bag on his shoulder, a businessman's polite unease, ID-photo framing
people.p_njambi: Kenyan woman, mid 60s, a headscarf, a heavy sweater, a hoe over her shoulder, watchful, ID-photo framing
people.p_mamamukoya: Kenyan woman, late 60s, a headscarf, an apron over a print dress, flour on her hands, tired and loving, ID-photo framing
people.p_tororo: East African man, about 40, a short-sleeved white office shirt, a pen behind his ear, a phone handset at his ear, bureaucratic, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_bank: scuffed churned mud at a river landing where two people stood, a clear evidence bag of the bank's sand held above it, reeds behind, close-up

people.p_grace: Kenyan woman, about 30, braids tied back, a plain office blazer, a lanyard with the card turned round, grieving and sharp, ID-photo framing
people.p_distrib: Kenyan man, mid 40s, a company polo shirt with no logo, a phone in his hand, reading glasses, careful, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_shelf: a pharmacy shelf of medicine boxes with six empty gaps in a row, and behind it in a stockroom doorway stacked cartons of the same boxes, labels out of focus
evidence.ev_soda: a red plastic soda crate on a car floor with one empty slot among full glass bottles, a handwritten tally card tucked in the side, close-up
evidence.ev_br_prints: a police ten-print fingerprint card on a desk, ten inked fingerprints in rows, an ink roller beside it, the name box out of focus

people.p_beth: Kenyan woman, late 30s, a neat short afro, a hospital records officer's cardigan with no badge, a folder held close, uneasy, ID-photo framing
people.p_japhet: Kenyan man, late 40s, a dark suit and tie, a court stamp pad in one hand, formal and tired, ID-photo framing
people.p_halima: Kenyan woman, early 40s, a dark trouser suit over a white blouse, a phone in her hand, composed and unsmiling, ID-photo framing
people.p_wairagu: Kenyan woman, about 60, short grey hair, a black advocate's jacket over a blouse, reading glasses, gracious and guarded, ID-photo framing
people.p_gitau: Kenyan man, mid 50s, a heavy greatcoat with plain buttons, a woollen cap, a torch, eyes that avoid yours, ID-photo framing

evidence.ev_drag: two faint parallel scuff lines in the polished floor of an old farmhouse hall, running from a study door towards a staircase, low raking light, close-up

ev_study.brief: an old farmhouse study at dusk, a rug turned back at one corner revealing a small dark mark on the floorboards, a clean polish-free circle on the floor by the door where a heavy doorstop stood, a hospital envelope on the desk

evidence.ev_cash: a locked steel cash box on an estate office desk beside a closed ledger, close-up
evidence.ev_rah_prints: a police ten-print fingerprint card on a desk, ten inked fingerprints in their boxes, an ink pad beside it, the name box out of focus
